raw.details:
About the Challenge: Can you turn a simple customer message into a professional invoice using AI?

KODNEXUS AI BUILD BATTLE is a free, 180-minute online build sprint where participants create a working AI-powered invoice automation tool. Your application should understand a customer's requirement written in plain natural language, extract key details, fetch service pricing from a connected sheet/database, and generate a clean, review-ready invoice.

Core Workflow to Build: Customer Requirement → AI Extraction → Price Lookup → Invoice Generation → Review/Approval Flow

Eligibility & Guidelines:

  • Participation: Individual participation only.
  • Registration: Free.
  • Build Time: 180 Minutes.
  • AI Tools: AI assistants and coding copilots are fully allowed.
  • Tech Stack: Any language or framework is welcome (Python, FastAPI, Streamlit, React, Next.js, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Groq, LangChain, Google Sheets API, Airtable, CSV/Excel).

Key Requirements

  • Natural-language customer input handling.
  • Structured entity extraction (Name, Email, Requested Services, Quantity, Notes).
  • Dynamic price lookup from a source (Google Sheets, Airtable, Excel, or CSV). The AI must NOT fabricate prices; missing items must be flagged for review.
  • Professional invoice layout from a template with correct total calculation.
  • Working review/approval step before final export/download.

Judging Criteria (100 Marks)

  • Functionality & Correctness: 30 Marks
  • AI Implementation & Prompting: 20 Marks
  • Price/Data Source Integration: 15 Marks
  • Invoice Quality & Usability: 15 Marks
  • Real-World Usefulness: 10 Marks
  • Creativity & Bonus Features (PDF export, WhatsApp share, tax, dashboard): 10 Marks

Submission Requirements:

  • Public GitHub Repository link
  • Live Demo / Deployed Link
  • Short Project Description (under 200 words)
  • Demo Video / Loom walkthrough (Optional)

Prizes & Recognition:

  • Winner: Internship Opportunity with Kodnexus + Winner Certificate + Social Media Feature
  • Top Performers: Achievement Certificate + Kodnexus Social Media Feature + Internship Consideration
  • All Submissions: Certificate of Participation

Official WhatsApp Group for Queries & Updates:

Join the community: https://chat.whatsapp.com/KMPObcIRaPEBGeLg082ZTo?s=cl&p=a&ilr=1
